objective: Execute GCL-03 — Situation & Scene Template Library. Build a broad parameterized library of reusable playable-situation shapes that deterministically materialize into the GCL-01 grammar while preserving MV-IA-F005/PPIA-08 reusable-definition versus Campaign-local placement/live-state boundaries.

acceptance_profile.breadth: At least 100 approved-library situation/scene templates across at least 10 scene families and multiple play emphases.
acceptance_profile.parameterization: Templates expose replaceable actor/location/object/resource/evidence/relationship/pressure/transition or equivalent slots rather than hard-coded Campaign facts.
acceptance_profile.scene_shape: Every template carries an opening situation, at least two open questions, pressure or turning-point prompts, and at least two possible exit vectors so it does not imply one golden path.
acceptance_profile.materialization: Compact entries expand through an explicit versioned profile into the GCL-01 shared grammar with no hidden defaults or authority promotion.
acceptance_profile.authority: All records retain runtime_authority none, canon_authority none and require owning-domain acceptance before becoming a Scene/Campaign structure.
acceptance_profile.f005_boundary: No reusable template creates Campaign-local placements, hidden/reveal state, objectives as runtime truth, launch readiness, launch snapshots, Session state or historical Events.
acceptance_profile.ppia08_boundary: Map/grid/placement/reveal/amendment fields may be referenced only as optional composition targets or unresolved governed references; GCL-03 owns no map calibration, placement or reveal mutation.
acceptance_profile.validation: The current AIOC repository-health validator checks exact library count, unique IDs, family coverage, declared placeholders/slots, multiple exits/open questions, deterministic materialization, runtime/canon nonauthority and F005/PPIA-08 boundary preservation before closeout.

required_inputs: MV-IA-F005 Campaign, Scene and Session Builder
CSW-05 Plot, Adventure and Narrative Design Lab
nonauthorization: canonical plot, resolved outcome or mandatory player choice
next_action: GCL-03 is completed_verified. On the next explicit Continue GCL, default to GCL-04 — Encounter Archetype Library unless another dependency-ready GCL successor is explicitly selected.
